CanonAdditions: The Gate of Silence is the first node in the channel network.
The seal is located at the intersection of the main channel and the drainage outflow at the Gate of Silence.
The channel leading to the seal descends rather than running flat, creating higher water pressure than a flat schematic implies.
The seal at the Gate of Silence is old and brittle.
The runes on the seal are tuned to a specific frequency.
Striking the seal with blunt force disrupts the resonance and causes the seal to fail.
Applying a sustained, low-frequency vibration weakens the bond of the seal without breaking the stone.
The Blight leaves a crystalline residue or anchor mark on metal surfaces.
A solvent for mineral deposits can dissolve Blight residue from brass without damaging the metal.
CanonChangesOverTime: The brass gauntlet previously hummed and vibrated; it is now still and silent.
WorldStateUpdates: The watchfort gatehouse contains a heavy oak table, a hearth, and a crate near the hearth.
The watchfort is located on high ground with thin air and a view of hills below.
The fog on the hills below the watchfort is burning away in the morning light.

NarrativeStateUpdates: The group has established a plan to weaken the seal at the Gate of Silence using sustained low-frequency vibration rather than blunt force.
The group has identified the need to clean the brass gauntlet of Blight residue before use.
The group is preparing to depart the watchfort at first light to travel to the Gate of Silence.
UnresolvedInformation: The exact depth or gradient of the channel descent is not known.
Whether the water pressure will exceed the barrier's intake rate is not established.
ExtractionWarnings: The chapter states Kaelen 'stepped out into the morning' and the door 'slammed shut behind Kaelen', but subsequent paragraphs describe the group still inside the gatehouse discussing and preparing. It is ambiguous whether Kaelen left the room permanently or if the narrative perspective shifted back to the interior group dynamics before his departure was finalized.
